summary: Confirms the defined test position where the documented secondary-control connection can remain available.
description: Confirms the defined test position where the documented secondary-control connection can remain available. Breaker status indications describe the operating mechanism, the removable truck or the health of a supporting system. These signals are related but are not interchangeable: an open breaker can still have its truck connected to live bus contacts.

In a switchgear control schematic, the bay controller compares independent status contacts before displaying a position or allowing another operation. The signal labels explain which physical state each contact represents. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Test-position limit contact” at the input and “Test-position status” at the output. Primary isolation depends on the selected assembly.
